name: git-client-baseline
summary: Build the git-client baseline: sidebar, toolbar, diffs everywhere
body:
The app previously had only the ism-specific three-pane view — none
of the furniture a git client owes its users. Now: a sidebar with
Local Changes (status counts), All Commits, the ism Change Stack, and
read-only branches/remotes/tags/stashes; fetch/pull/push toolbar verbs
with their stderr tails surfaced; a working-tree view (file list with
status chips, diff against HEAD, untracked via --no-index); a commit
list with author/sha/date columns whose selection shows the full
commit diff; and a shared DiffView with context rows, hunk-gap
dividers and horizontal scroll for long lines. Views auto-land where
the work is: dirty worktree → changes, pending stack → stack, else
history.
